selection: All nine official real recordings, up to 12 nonoverlapping two-second windows per recording, uniformly spaced from start to end. If shorter than 24s, use floor(duration/2) windows. No score-based selection, replacement, or exclusion.
input_eligibility: Source FPS must be at least 8 to provide 16 distinct frames in two seconds, and decoded best-effort PTS must be CFR. Lower-FPS or discontinuous-PTS recordings remain in the candidate ledger as NOT SCORED; no upsampling, slowed playback, duplicate frames, PTS repair, or replacements.

sampling.timestamp_origin: Use FFmpeg best-effort decoded presentation timestamps relative to first frame. Verify all decoded frames; count decoded frames, not AVI header packets. OpenCV AVI tail timestamps are diagnostic only.

labels.source: score-blind agent visual review of sampled RGB frames; NOT official motion/static ground truth
labels.static: No visually evident object, camera, or natural background motion in the sampled clip; subtle motion uncertainty goes to ambiguous
labels.motion: Visually evident coherent object, camera, or natural scene motion
labels.ambiguous: Unclear or mixed evidence; retain in robustness summaries but do not use for static/motion discrimination

repair_preprocessing: Unchanged full-frame bilinear antialiased resize to 384 square, rectangular guard relaxation only; verify exact preprocessing, feature and head parity on prior square TRAIN reference.

analysis.primary: all selected windows, irrespective of visual label
analysis.secondary: static/motion/ambiguous separately; threshold-free AUROC only if both reviewed classes exist
analysis.acceptance: descriptive external validation; no new score calibration, threshold fitting, or checkpoint selection

limitations: Nine recordings, possibly sharing sites; windows are not independent sources
Sparse official foreground masks cannot certify whole-clip stillness; reviewed labels are not benchmark motion-intensity ground truth
Nearest-frame sampling has at most half a source-frame temporal rounding error; no invented or repeated still-image video
Author page requests citation; no explicit standardized dataset license verified, so original videos are not redistributed
This is not official BMC foreground segmentation evaluation or physical motion-strength calibration
